node.title: (A) SHARPENED: trades = torsion points on the UNIVERSAL variety W_h
node.statement: The x83 obstruction polynomials depend only on h: define W_h in G_m^{2h} (obstructions = 0, triangular, explicit). Trades at any row = points of W_h with mu_n coordinates. The obstructions are quasi-homogeneous (O_j(gamma R) = gamma^{2h-j} O_j(R) — verified), so counts are scaling/Galois-orbit invariant. This reframes (A) from subgroup point-counting to TORSION POINTS ON A FIXED SUBVARIETY OF A TORUS — classical territory.
node.notes: Roadmap-lane derivation. The universality (n-independence) is the leverage every prior route lacked. | UPGRADED to PROVED: universality = Lemma 0's graph structure (proved, replayed); quasi-homogeneity = the pilot's isobaric verification (7/7). Both claims machine-checked.
